explanation.headline: Scopolamine is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; a prior discontinuation posting for Padagis US LLC was dated 2025-11-03

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows scopolamine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
A previous FDA posting for Padagis US LLC scopolamine transdermal system was marked "To Be Discontinued" with an initial posting date of 2025-11-03.
Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 10.4 days at Corvale East, 14.8 days at Corvale General, and 17 days at Corvale Lakeside.
The top-ranked purchasing option per the decision rule is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Additional alternate manufacturers include Baxter Healthcare Corporation and Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC, also not on the shortage list.
One registered plant for a scopolamine label is Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3008957483) in India, last inspected 2024-07-19 with a VAI classification.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
